# Errors

A second child, so the section has more than one and the folder's ordering rule has
something to order. It carries a distinct icon, which is what makes the sprite
assertion meaningful: one `<symbol>` per distinct icon however many pages use it.

It also links across a repository boundary: the
[Fieldkit SDK's errors](@fieldkit:typescript-sdk/errors) live in another repository,
addressed by slug with the default namespace left out. Fieldkit is readable by
`engineering` alone, so for every other reader of this page the link is an ordinary
one that 404s — no marker, no preview.
